trainer.name: Wesley
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Wesley: The sea on the way to the League is rough. Only the toughest swimmers make it this far!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Wesley: I'm tough. You're tougher.

trainer.name: Ricardo
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Ricardo: Mind where you surf! My Tentacruel's tentacles reach a long, long way!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Ricardo: All those tentacles, and not one of them could catch you.

trainer.name: Francisco
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Francisco: My Golduck taught me how to swim. Now it's going to teach you a lesson!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Francisco: Looks like we're the ones who need more lessons.

trainer.name: Colton
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Colton: Out here, trouble comes from the sky and the sea at once. Can you watch both?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Colton: You kept your eyes open, all right.

trainer.name: Troy
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Troy: One Pokémon is all I need, as long as it's a Gyarados!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Troy: Maybe I need a second one after all.

trainer.name: Oscar
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Oscar: Mantine and Remoraid swim side by side in these waters. My team and I do too!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Oscar: We'll swim off and lick our wounds together, then.

trainer.name: Miranda
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Miranda: Lumineon's fins glow in deep water. Pretty, isn't it? It's pretty strong, too!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Miranda: Pretty, yes. Strong enough... not today.

trainer.name: Aubree
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Aubree: Bibarel isn't fast, but it never, ever gets tired. We'll swim rings round you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Aubree: You swam rings round us instead.

trainer.name: Paige
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Paige: The Pokémon League is just up the waterfall. Bet you can't get past me first!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Paige: Bet lost. Go on, then: the waterfall's that way.

trainer.name: Crystal
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Crystal: The water out here is so clear I can see right to the bottom!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Crystal: And now I can see clearly that I've lost.

trainer.name: Cassandra
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Cassandra: Training on the open sea makes Pokémon stronger than any pool ever could!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Cassandra: Seems the open sea has made you stronger still.

trainer.name: Gabrielle
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Gabrielle: Heading for the Pokémon League? You'll have to cross the sea first, and that means me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Gabrielle: Good luck at the League. You'll need less of it than most.

trainer.name: Zachariah
trainer.dialogueBefore: Sailor Zachariah: I've sailed every sea there is, and none has waves like these. Steady yourself!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Sailor Zachariah: Knocked flat by someone riding on a Pokémon's back. Well, I never!
